نصباح (form XI)
# نَصْبَاحُّ (naṣbāḥḥu) /nasˤ.baːħ.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# نَصْبَاحَّ (naṣbāḥḥa) /nasˤ.baːħ.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# نَصْبَاحِّ (naṣbāḥḥi) /nasˤ.baːħ.ħi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
